0022600140.text: The Pelicans (0-3, on a three-game losing streak and 13th in the West) host the Denver Nuggets (1-1 and 8th in the West). New Orleans is without Yves Missi, who is out with a knee bruise, while Denver is missing Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring). The Pelicans trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing 141-135 in Denver on October 24, and they lost all three meetings in the 2025-26 season.
